match.reason: MatchJob computes a live job-posting embedding before it ever reaches the LLM fit-analysis step. The real LiteLLM gateway's `embed` model group (openai/text-embedding-3-small, gateway/config.yaml) has no API key configured in this environment's .env (no OPENAI_API_KEY at all) — a pre-existing gap, not caused by this migration. Every attempt failed identically on BOTH the Go and Python path with the same upstream 401, so no comparison was possible either way.
match.action_needed: A real OpenAI API key (or a working alternate embed provider) needs to be configured in the LiteLLM gateway before match or embed can be baselined.

embed.reason: Same root cause as match — the embed model group itself has no credential.

recruiter.go_path: real call via internal/platform/llm, real openrouter/deepseek response, correctly extracted {name, title, email} from a synthetic posting mentioning a named recruiter
recruiter.python_path_direct: real call to apps/ai's /v1/capabilities/recruiter/invoke, same input, structurally identical output shape (name/title/email/phone/linkedin_url)
recruiter.python_path_via_go: verified the full Go -> aiclient -> apps/ai -> real LLM -> Go persistence chain succeeds (aiclient log: capability=recruiter status=succeeded), reverting AI_CAPABILITY_ROUTING back to go afterward and confirming the Go path still works unaffected
recruiter.verdict: Functionally correct on all three paths. Single sample only (LLM cost discipline) — not enough runs to make a numeric parity claim, but no structural or correctness gap found. Reasonable cutover candidate once more samples are taken; not deleted here.

outreach.python_path_direct: real call to apps/ai's /v1/capabilities/outreach/invoke with synthetic facts, produced a genuinely grounded message referencing the exact facts supplied
outreach.go_path_and_full_chain: NOT exercised — outreach's Go-side fact-gathering (GroundClaims prerequisite) found no real Application/fact data for the synthetic job, so it took its existing no-LLM generic-opener fallback on both the go and python routing runs; the aiclient was never actually called in either case
outreach.verdict: Python capability itself proven correct and grounded. The Go call-site wiring's happy path (real facts -> real AI call) was not exercised live — would need a fuller synthetic Application/facts dataset to test.

rephrase.python_path_direct: real call to apps/ai's /v1/capabilities/rephrase/invoke, 'Led the migration...' correctly rephrased term 'led' -> 'Directed', grounded and correct
rephrase.go_path_and_full_chain: NOT exercised — rephrase's only Go caller repointed so far is coach (T107), and coach/assess requires a keyword-diff to exist first, which itself requires match to have run — inherits match's embed-credential blocker
rephrase.verdict: Python capability proven correct. The coach->aiclient->rephrase chain specifically could not be exercised due to the transitive match/embed blocker, unrelated to rephrase itself.

overall_recommendation: Do not delete any of these five Go paths yet (T113 held back for match/rephrase/recruiter/outreach/embed). The blocker for match/embed is a real, fixable infra gap (add an embed provider API key) unrelated to code correctness. recruiter/outreach/rephrase's Python capabilities are proven correct; a second live-testing pass after the embed credential is fixed would let match/embed be tested for the first time and let rephrase's coach chain be exercised, at which point a normal multi-sample parity check (like ghost's and salary's) becomes possible for all five.
